pool.text: A commuter travels from City A to City B at an average speed of 60 miles per hour and returns along the same route at an average speed of 40 miles per hour. What is the commuter's average speed, in miles per hour, for the entire round trip?

pool.sol: Average speed is total distance divided by total time. Let the one-way distance be \( d \). Time going is \( d/60 \) and time returning is \( d/40 \). Total time: \( d/60 + d/40 = 5d/120 = d/24 \). Average speed: \( \dfrac{2d}{d/24} = 2 \times 24 = 48 \text{ mph} \).
hints: Average speed is total distance divided by total time.
Let the one-way distance be \( d \). Time going is \( d/60 \) and time returning is \( d/40 \). Total time: \( d/60 + d/40 = 5d/120 = d/24 \).
Average speed: \(\dfrac{2d}{d/24} = 2 \times 24\).

pool.text: Two runners run around a 400-meter circular track in opposite directions starting from the same point at the same time. Runner A runs at 5 m/s and Runner B runs at 3 m/s. How many seconds will elapse before they pass each other for the first time?
